canonical_example.text: No se me queda la lección después de haberla aprendido.
canonical_example.translation: I can't remember the lesson after I learned it.

canonical_example.text: Mi abuelo se quedó ciego cuando tenía 80 y pico años.
canonical_example.translation: My granddad went blind when he was 80 something.

canonical_example.text: No trates de quedarte conmigo. Hicimos un trato.
canonical_example.translation: Don't try to kid me. We made a deal.

canonical_example.text: "No temas", dijo con voz queda.
canonical_example.translation: "Don't be afraid," he said in a quiet voice.

canonical_example.text: Se escuchaban unos pasos quedos acercándose por el pasillo.
canonical_example.translation: Soft steps could be heard approaching along the corridor.

canonical_example.text: Hablaban quedo, pero aún así yo podía escuchar lo que decían.
canonical_example.translation: They spoke quietly, but even so I could hear what they were saying.

canonical_example.text: Se había dormido y respiraba muy quedo.
canonical_example.translation: She had fallen asleep and was breathing very softly.

antonyms.context: to step down; often used with "de"
to move from one place to another

canonical_example.text: La vacuna tarda unos días en ser efectiva.
canonical_example.translation: The vaccine takes a few days to become effective.

canonical_example.text: Pagué con tarjeta porque no llevaba efectivo.
canonical_example.translation: I paid by card because I didn't have any cash on me.

canonical_example.text: El poder efectivo está en manos del pueblo.
canonical_example.translation: The real power is in the hands of the people.

canonical_example.text: La posibilidad efectiva de que sobreviva este pajarito es muy escasa.
canonical_example.translation: The actual chance that this baby bird will survive is very slim.

canonical_example.text: No se ha podido determinar el valor efectivo de las pérdidas.
canonical_example.translation: It has not been possible to determine the true value of the losses.

canonical_example.text: El país aumentó el número de efectivos militares en la zona.
canonical_example.translation: The country increased the number of military forces in the area.
